horizon_basis: V15b read-only diagnosis of the V15 walker2d B0 arrays: every target segment stays within the 8.4e-4 gate for at least 403 steps (segments 3/5/6 first exceed at steps 468/404/965); H = 400. Fixed by the user on 2026-11-12 after that diagnosis and before any walker2d source-trajectory result existed; this is the second rule adjustment made after seeing a B0 result.
rule: T_H=min(T,H), L_H=min(L,H). Untrackable if median T_H < 200 and fraction(T_H/L_H >= 0.8) < 0.1; trackable if fraction >= 0.5; otherwise uncertain. Judged on B2 only, one-step greedy tracking only. Residuals within the first H steps are reported descriptively.
source_selection: identical to V15: seed 2026111501, 500 complete source trajectories with unclipped first observation; asserted equal to the V15 frozen plan
failure_policy: No retry. Any exception, NaN/Inf or hash mismatch stops and keeps the evidence.
